Wrote channels.json from the "starter" preset: 2 text and 4 voice channels.

  #general   text, auto-join
  #offtopic  text
  Lounge     voice
  Gaming     voice
  Private    voice, max 5, password
  AFK        voice, no screen share

Passwords — shown this once; channels.json keeps only their hashes:
  Private  kwsy-fk3r-d7m4

Restart the server to load it. To change a password for good, put
"password": "…" in place of that channel's "password_hash".

- Anyone can still open a room of their own with the + button; it goes away once it has been empty for a while.
